description: Static seed manifest for the OfflineParity benchmark. The action table is externalized to actions.jsonl (one action per line) so hosted-static-CI line-count validation covers it like the other benchmarks. action_count must equal the non-empty line count of actions.jsonl. Re-generate actions.jsonl from offline_parity_benchmark.py if the table changes.

placeholder_tokens.{{decision_id}}: chain-discovered decision id; rows with requires=decision_id SKIP when absent

scoring.match_rate: fraction of non-skipped actions with status=MATCH (includes expected_error and expected_offline rows where the two offline tools agree on the failure)
scoring.diff_rate: fraction of non-skipped actions with status=DIFF (genuine exe-vs-py disagreement, including one-sided offline_unsupported failures)
scoring.error_rate: fraction of non-skipped actions with status=ERROR (unexpected real tool/process/parse failures only)
scoring.environment_blocked_count: number of rows invalidated when the run-level read-only preflight detects monolith_query's exact fail-closed active rollback-journal message; a blocked run has zero comparable actions and score 0.0
scoring.version_parity_score: 1.0 if exe parity_spec_rev == py parity_spec_rev, else 0.0

buckets.expected_error: Deliberate negative-path probe (bad input). Both tools should exit non-zero; both-fail => MATCH (error_kind=expected). One-sided or both-succeed => DIFF.
buckets.offline_unsupported: Action whose offline surface may legitimately be absent. If BOTH offline tools agree on the failure (both exit non-zero) parity holds => MATCH (error_kind=expected_offline). Only a genuine exe-vs-py disagreement (exactly one tool fails) => DIFF (error_kind=offline_parity_break). If both succeed, outputs are compared normally.
buckets.normal: Standard parity row. Either tool exiting non-zero => ERROR (error_kind=real).

runtime_classifications.environment_blocked: Before chain discovery and scoring, a global --readonly Query preflight detects the exact active rollback-journal safety refusal. It invalidates every row as SKIP(environment_blocked), forces zero comparable actions and score 0.0, and does not launch the Python reader. After preflight, the same marker is ERROR(real), never a row-level SKIP. Generic lock/process errors are not reclassified.
